map.记录恒牙中龋坏（D）、因龋缺失（M）、因龋充填（F）的牙数，评估个体龋病经历。: Record the numbers of decayed (D), missing due to caries (M) and filled due to caries (F) teeth among permanent teeth to assess the individual's caries experience.
map.填写「因龋缺失牙数 M」。: Enter "teeth missing due to caries M".
map.填写「因龋充填牙数 F」。: Enter "teeth filled due to caries F".
map.个体口腔检查后登记 D/M/F 牙数，工具汇总 DMFT 总分并定位高风险牙位。: After the individual oral examination, register the D/M/F tooth counts; the tool totals the DMFT score and locates high-risk tooth positions.
map.群体口腔流调按年龄分层统计平均 DMFT，比较龋病流行水平。: Population oral surveys stratify by age and report mean DMFT to compare caries prevalence.
map.防龋干预一年后复查 DMFT 增量，评估措施效果。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初: Check the DMFT increment one year after anti-caries intervention to assess the effect. (Results are for oral health education and self-screening reference only, and do not replace oral examination, periapical/CBCT imaging, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists and periodontists; if you have toothache, bleeding gums, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or bite discomfort, seek care promptly at a qualified hospital dental department.)
map.：输入：龋坏牙 D=3，因龋缺失 M=1，因龋充填 F=4\n计算：DMFT =:
: input: decayed teeth D=3, missing due to caries M=1, filled due to caries F=4
calculation: DMFT = D + M + F = 3 + 1 + 4 = 8
note: the higher the score, the more caries experience, so strengthen topical fluoride and dietary management.
map.牙龈指数(GI)与出血指数评估器: Gingival Index (GI) and Bleeding Index Assessor
map.DMFT 用于恒牙，dmft 用于乳牙（d 龋坏、m 因龋缺失、f 因龋充填）；: DMFT is for permanent teeth, dmft for primary teeth (d decayed, m missing due to caries, f filled due to caries); during the mixed-dentition period both must be recorded separately.
map.每颗牙按最严重状态计 1 次（D/M/F 取其一），同一牙不重复计分；已充填且有: Each tooth is scored once by its most severe state (one of D/M/F), and the same tooth is not counted twice; a filled tooth with active caries counts as D.
map.代表该口径下无龋坏、无因龋缺失、无因龋充填的牙，是防龋目标状态，但仍需定期口腔检: Representing teeth with no caries, none missing due to caries and none filled due to caries under this convention — the anti-caries target state, but regular oral checks are still needed.
